name: T-Systems Magdeburg TwinCore Data Center
notes: T Cloud Public states the German twin-core data center is located in Magdeburg and Biere; Exyte reference identifies the Magdeburg greenfield Twin-Core project with 7 x 1,200 m2 IT modules plus network facilities. Capacity not disclosed.

name: GreenRock Rothenschirmbach Datacenter
notes: GreenRock announced a logistics/data-center concept in the Rothenschirmbach industrial area, Lutherstadt Eisleben, with Mitnetz reservation confirmation for up to 300 MW grid capacity and a planned adjusted building application in Q4 2026.

name: Landkreis Saalekreis Blösien Administrative Data Center
notes: Saalekreis is planning a new county administration data center at the FTZ Blösien site; EU tender 299482-2025 covers planning services for 'Neubau Rechenzentrum am Standort Blösien'. Public sources did not disclose IT load or power capacity.

name: T-Systems Biere Cloud Data Center
notes: Deutsche Telekom says the Biere data center in Bördeland opened on 2014-07-03, has around 100,000 servers, about 11,000 m2 total area, about 970 PB of data, PUE below 1.3, and forms a TwinCore with Magdeburg. MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Rechenzentrum für Apotheken Hildegard Schröter GmbH
developer: Rechenzentrum für Apotheken Hildegard Schröter GmbH
notes: Official site and imprint list the pharmacy billing/data-processing center at Lutherstraße 53, 06886 Lutherstadt Wittenberg. This is a specialized small data-processing/rechenzentrum business; no facility power data found.

name: Stadt Brunsbüttel Compact Data Center Container
notes: Dierck Datacenter reference describes a modular concrete compact data center for Stadt Brunsbüttel in Kreis Dithmarschen with 4 server racks, expandable to 5, 10 kW cooling and 10 kW modular UPS, both 2n redundant.

name: Dänische Schule Flensburg Server Room
notes: Dierck Datacenter reference says the administration of Dänische Schule Flensburg was modernized in 2014 with a server room containing 6 server cabinets, efficient chilled-water inline cooling, hot-aisle containment, modular power strips and IT monitoring.

name: CSN-Solutions Gudow Green Data Center
notes: CSN-Solutions official pages advertise a certified data center in Gudow powered by 100% renewable energy; Cloudiax lists CSN-Solutions, Kastanienallee 11, 23899 Gudow/Kehrsen as its German colocation data center with N+1 power and cooling.

name: ADDIX DC2 / Hörn Campus Kiel
notes: ADDIX official pages describe its Kiel data center/server housing at Hörn Campus, Kaistraße 101; Data Center Map lists ADDIX DC2, and DC Hub reports 3.0 MW operational capacity.

name: ennit Data Center Kiel
notes: Data Center Map lists ennit Data Center at Projensdorfer Straße 324, 24106 Kiel and ennit Data Center 2 at Gerhard-Fröhler-Straße 12; ennit states it is based in Kiel and operates modern data-center technology. Public MW capacity not found.

name: euNetworks Colocation Kiel
notes: Data Center Map and Datacenters.com list euNetworks Colocation Kiel at Holzkoppelweg 17, 24118 Kiel, with Datacenters.com reporting 5,414 sq ft of raised-floor colocation space. No power capacity disclosed.

name: Städtisches Krankenhaus Kiel Server Room
notes: Dierck Datacenter reference says the municipal hospital in Kiel planned a new server room in 2016; Dierck built a room with 6 server cabinets, 252 rack units, row cooling with aisle containment, and a fully modular UPS system with 3x10 kW redundant design.
